extDesc.message: 2FA codes in nested folders with an archive. Encrypted sync with your Android phone through your own Google Drive.

migration_fail.message: Import mislyktes. Hvis du migrerer data fra Google Authenticator, vennligst eksporter dataene fra Google Authenticator og prøv på nytt.

confirm_delete.message: Er du sikker på at du vil slette denne brukeren? Denne handlingen kan ikke angres.

confirm_delete_all.message: Jeg forstår at alle mine data ikke vil bli gjenopprettet slettet.
confirm_delete_all.description: Message that user is required to acknowledge before clearing all data.

delete_all_warning.message: Dette vil slette alle dataene dine og alle nullstille autentisering. Du vil ikke kunne gjenopprette noen slettede data! Du bør vurdere å lagre en sikkerhetskopi før du tilbakestiller autentisering.

security_warning.message: Dette passordet vil bli brukt til å kryptere kontoene dine. Ingen kan hjelpe deg hvis du glemmer passordet.

phrase_incorrect.message: Du kan ikke legge til en ny konto før alle kontoer er dekryptert. Skriv inn riktig passord før du fortsetter.

phrase_incorrect_export.message: Kontoer som ikke var i stand til å dekryptere vil ikke inkluderes i denne sikkerhetskopien.

passphrase_info.message: Skriv inn passordet for å dekryptere konto data.

clock_too_far_off.message: Forsiktig! Din lokale klokke er for langt unna. Vennligst fiks den før du fortsetter.
clock_too_far_off.description: Local Time is Too Far Off

remind_backup.message: Har du en sikkerhetskopi for kontoene dine? Ikke vent til det er for sent!

capture_failed.message: Opptak mislyktes, vennligst last inn siden på nytt og prøv igjen.

capture_local_file_failed.message: Prøver du å skanne QR-kode fra en lokal fil? Bruk importer QR-bildesikkerhetskopiering i stedet.
capture_local_file_failed.description: Import QR image backup instead of scan local image

export_info.message: Advarsel: alle sikkerhetskopier er ikke kryptert. Vil du legge til en konto i en annen app? Hold musepekeren over øvre høyre del av kontoen, og trykk på den skjulte knappen.

import_qr_images.description: Import qr images. Shown as add account method.

import_otp_urls.description: Import OTP URLs. Shown as add account method.

import_backup_qr_partly_failed.message: Import vellykket, men noen QR-koder kunne ikke gjenkjennes.
import_backup_qr_partly_failed.description: Import successful, but some QR image cannot be recognized.

import_backup_qr_in_batches.message: Du kan velge flere filer å importere i bunt.
import_backup_qr_in_batches.description: You can select multiple image files to import backup in batches.

dropbox_risk.message: Advarsel: sikkerhetskopier er ikke kryptert. Bruk på egen risiko.

import_error_password.message: Du må oppgi riktig passord for å importere sikkerhetskopier.
import_error_password.description: Error password warning when import backups.

local_passphrase_warning.message: Passordet ditt er lagret lokalt, vennligst endre det i sikkerhetsmenyen umiddelbart.

popout.description: Make window turn into persistent popup

storage_sync_info.message: Sikkerhetskopier dataene dine automatisk til tredjeparts lagringstjenester.

sign_in.description: Sign in to 3rd party storage services

sign_in_business.description: Sign in to 3rd party storage services

log_out.description: Sign out of 3rd party storage services

token_revoked.message: Det oppsto et problem med tilkoblingen til $SERVICE$ -kontoen din, vennligst logg deg på igjen.
token_revoked.description: Error authenticating to backup service. $SERVICE$ will be replaced with a proper noun (E.g.: 'Google Drive' or 'Dropbox')

otp_unsupported_warn.message: Du har en eller flere Steam- eller Blizzard-kontoer. Ikke-krypterte sikkerhetskopier bruker ikke standardisert backup-format.
otp_unsupported_warn.description: Warning if using account that is not supported by standard backup format.

otp_backup_inform.message: Du kan importere sikkerhetskopier fra noen andre applikasjoner.

otp_backup_learn.description: learn more link on import page. Placed after otp_backup_inform

password_policy_default_hint.message: Passordet ditt oppfyller ikke organisasjonens sikkerhetskrav. Kontakt systemansvarlig for mer informasjon.

advisor_insight_password_not_set.message: Angi et passord for å beskytte dine data.

advisor_insight_auto_lock_not_set.message: Aktiver automatisk lås for å beskytte dine data.

advisor_insight_browser_sync_not_enabled.message: Synkronisering i nettleseren er deaktivert. Aktivering av kontoene kan synkroniseres på tvers av nettlesere.

advisor_insight_auto_fill_not_enabled.message: Autofyll kan aktiveres automatisk for å fylle koder inn på nettsteder.

advisor_insight_smart_filter_not_enabled.message: Aktivering av smart filter gir rask tilgang til kontoer.

no_insight_available.message: Ingen innsikt funnet, alt ser bra ut!

no_entires.message: Ingen kontoer å vise. Legg til din første konto nå.

permission_required.message: Dette er en nødvendig tillatelse og kan ikke tilbakekalles.

permission_active_tab.message: Få tilgang til denne fanen for å skanne QR-koder.

permission_storage.message: Tilgang til nettleserlagring for å lagre kontodata.

permission_scripting.message: Injiser skript inn i denne fanen for å skanne QR-koder og la autoutfylle fungere.

permission_clipboard_write.message: Gir skrivetilgang til utklippstavlen for å kopiere koder til utklippstavlen når du klikker på kontoen.

permission_drive_cannot_revoke.message: Du må deaktivere Google Drive sikkerhetskopiering først.

permission_onedrive_cannot_revoke.message: Du må deaktivere OneDrive sikkerhetskopiering først.

permission_unknown_permission.message: Ukjent tillatelse. Hvis du ser denne meldingen, vennligst send en feilrapport.

activate_auto_filter.message: Advarsel: Smartfilter samsvarer ikke med domenenavnet til en konto. Kontroller alltid at du er på korrekt nettside før du skriver inn en kode!

ungrouped.description: Default section header for accounts without a folder.

folder_placeholder.description: Placeholder for the folder name input.

folder_picker.description: Label/aria for the folder picker button.

toggle_folders.description: Title for the header button that expands or collapses all folders.

archive.description: Title of the bottom-anchored archive section.

archive_move.description: Context menu action to archive an account.

archive_restore.description: Context menu action to unarchive an account.

archive_empty.description: Hint shown when the archive section is empty.

rating_prompt_text.message: Enjoying Authenticator Folders? Please consider leaving a review.
rating_prompt_text.description: One-time banner asking the user to rate the extension.

rating_prompt_text_mobile.message: Enjoying Authenticator Folders? Please consider giving the project a star on GitHub.
rating_prompt_text_mobile.description: Android app only: one-time banner inviting a GitHub star.

rating_prompt_rate.description: Rating banner button that opens the store reviews page.

rating_prompt_later.description: Rating banner button that hides the banner for 30 days.

rating_prompt_no.description: Rating banner button that hides the banner permanently.

sync_title.description: Title of the sync settings page.

sync_intro.message: Upload your accounts to your own Google Drive, or download them from it. The data is encrypted on this device with a sync passphrase before it leaves, and is stored in a hidden app-data folder that only this extension can see.
sync_intro.description: Explanation of how Drive sync works.

sync_warning_unrecoverable.message: Only you know the sync passphrase. If you forget it, the data on Drive cannot be recovered by anyone, including the developer.

sync_no_warranty.message: No warranty: this feature is provided as is. The developer never receives or stores your data. It lives only in your own Google Drive, encrypted with your passphrase. You are responsible for keeping your own backups.

sync_passphrase_new_info.message: There is no sync file on Drive yet. Choose a sync passphrase. It is different from the password that protects this extension.
sync_passphrase_new_info.description: Info about creating a new passphrase.

sync_passphrase_mismatch.message: The two passphrases do not match.

sync_working.message: Working. Deriving the key can take a few seconds.

sync_unlock_first.message: Unlock the extension with your password first. Locked accounts cannot be synced.

sync_conflict_info.message: Nothing has been changed yet. Choose what to do.

sync_this_device.description: Label for this device in conflict dialog.

sync_drive.description: Label for Google Drive in conflict dialog.

sync_choice_add.description: Option to add missing items only.

sync_choice_overwrite.message: Overwrite changed accounts on the side being changed
sync_choice_overwrite.description: Option to also overwrite changed items.

sync_choice_mirror.description: Option to delete items missing on other side.

sync_choice_add_info.message: Adds accounts that the target does not have. Nothing is overwritten or deleted.

sync_choice_overwrite_info.message: Also copies the changed values (name, folder, archive, and so on) over matching accounts on the target. Nothing is deleted.

sync_choice_mirror_info.message: Also deletes accounts on the target that are not on the other side, so the target becomes identical.

sync_target_changes.message: The following side will be changed:
sync_target_changes.description: Label showing which side will be changed.

sync_confirm_mirror.message: This deletes accounts that the other side does not have. Continue?

sync_in_sync.message: Already in sync. Nothing was changed.

sync_nothing_on_drive.message: There is nothing on Drive yet. Upload first.

sync_erase_confirm.message: Delete the sync file from your Drive? Your accounts on this device are not touched.

sync_error_not_configured.message: Sync is not set up in this build (no Google OAuth client ID).
sync_error_not_configured.description: Error when sync is not configured.

sync_error_auth.message: Google sign-in was not completed or was denied.

sync_error_network.message: Could not reach Google Drive. Check your connection.

sync_error_http.description: Error when Drive returns HTTP error.

sync_error_wrong_passphrase.message: Wrong passphrase, or the file on Drive is damaged. Nothing was changed.

sync_error_bad_file.message: The file on Drive is not readable by this version.

sync_error_permission.message: The permission needed to sign in with Google was not granted.

download_backup_otpauth.message: Export for other apps (otpauth, no folders)
download_backup_otpauth.description: Button to export in otpauth format without folders.
